subject.title: feat: add private AWS workspace service

question: Should Crabbox core permanently own and support this dedicated-account AWS workspace service and its ECS, IAM, networking, bearer-auth, and operating contract?
rationale: The patch adds a substantial opt-in product and configuration surface whose ongoing deployment and security obligations cannot be accepted solely from implementation correctness or CI results.

options.title: Approve after live acceptance
options.body: Accept the service as a core deployment mode after the documented target-account lifecycle and upgrade evidence passes and the changelog edit is removed.

options.title: Keep deployment outside core
options.body: Retain only generic provider capabilities in Crabbox and maintain the dedicated stack and account-specific runbook as a separately owned deployment package.

options.title: Pause the service
options.body: Close or defer the PR if no maintainer or operator can own its cloud security boundary and recurring live acceptance requirements.

recommendation.title: Approve after live acceptance
recommendation.body: Accept the service as a core deployment mode after the documented target-account lifecycle and upgrade evidence passes and the changelog edit is removed.

likelyOwner.reason: His current-main history includes the portable Node coordinator and recent AWS coordinator evolution, making him the best available owner for this product-boundary choice.
